nodes.label: Alert dedupe mechanism (fire-once-until-clear)
nodes.rationale: Each alert condition fires once when it first triggers, then stays quiet until it clears and re-triggers later, so the bot does not send repeated pings every hour for a still-active condition.

nodes.label: Telegram Q&A bot (Claude-backed)
nodes.rationale: Only messages from the chat ID configured in TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are answered, so a stranger who discovers the bot's username cannot run up the owner's Anthropic API bill; each question is answered independently with no memory of earlier messages yet.

nodes.label: Current stock watchlist (IDX tickers)
nodes.rationale: BBCA.JK, BBRI.JK, AMMN.JK, WIIM.JK, WIFI.JK were explicitly requested tickers; BMRI.JK, TLKM.JK, ASII.JK, UNVR.JK, ICBP.JK were added as widely cited stable, large-cap IDX picks (banking, telecom, conglomerate, consumer staples) with consistent dividends across market cycles.

nodes.label: Jakarta (WIB) trading-hours schedule
nodes.rationale: Analysis runs hourly from 09:00 to 16:00 WIB on weekdays because the watchlist is dominated by IDX (Indonesia Stock Exchange)-listed tickers, so the schedule mirrors local market hours.
